papers_read.title_as_printed: Signal and Texture Features from T2 Maps for the Prediction of Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Progression (Trejo-Castro et al., Healthcare 2021)
Early MCI-to-AD Conversion Prediction Using Future Value Forecasting of Multimodal Features (Minhas et al., Comput. Intell. Neurosci. 2021)

what_each_reports.P-183: Baseline T2-map signal/texture + volumes + neuropsychology; n=40 (18 MCIp converting at the 2-year visit, 22 MCIs stable at least 5 years); ensemble AUC 0.824 (95% CI 0.681-0.968); 100 random 80/20 splits.
what_each_reports.P-186: Linear SVM on neuropsychological + MRI marker trajectories (two observed visits plus one forecast value); conversion before month 36, ADNI-1; 1-year-ahead AUC 95.7% (n=85), 6-month-ahead 91.2% (n=119); 5-fold CV.

quantity_a: ROC-AUC, extreme-group MCI conversion (converted at 2 years vs stable at least 5 years), ages 70-80, baseline T2-map radiomics + neuropsychology, n=40.
quantity_b: ROC-AUC, conversion before month 36 in ADNI-1 MCI with complete consecutive visits, from forecast three-point longitudinal trajectories of neuropsychology + T1 morphometry, n=85 (or 119).
incompatible_if_same: No. P-183's 95% CI (0.681-0.968) contains both of P-186's figures (0.912 and 0.957).

gates.task: match nominally (T2), but the class definitions and the need for longitudinal visits differ.
gates.dataset_family: match: ADNI in both; overlap with ADNI-1 MCI possible.
gates.modality_family: mismatch, not waived: T2 relaxometry maps + neuropsychology vs T1 FreeSurfer morphometry + neuropsychology trajectories.

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: same metric (ROC-AUC) but different class definitions, input representation (single baseline visit vs forecast longitudinal trajectories that include a value at the time of conversion) and eligible populations.
performance_validity: flag does not apply: 0.824 and 0.957 are below 0.97; both flags false. Both samples are small (40 and 85).
grounds: P-186's figure comes from trajectories that include a forecast marker value at the time of conversion, while P-183 uses one baseline visit; the input representations differ.
The class definitions differ (conversion at 2 years vs 5-year stable controls, against conversion before month 36 vs stable to month 36), and the modality gate fails with no waiver.
Even on a shared quantity there would be no contradiction: P-183's CI covers both P-186 figures.

evidence_quotes.quote: The experiment included only the baseline information from subjects with a baseline MCI diagnosis, between 70 and 80 years old
Te proposed technique resulted in a high classiﬁcation AUC of 91.2% and 95.7% for 6-month- and 1-year-ahead AD prediction, respectively, using multimodal markers.

Te method proposed in this paper has recorded the highest classiﬁcation AUC of 95.7% predominantly because of involving the forecasted marker value at the time of conversion as a classiﬁcation feature.

record_defects: The registry Best_Metric for P-183 'Acc 72.7' does not appear in the PDF.
claim_b gives P-186 'AUC 0.957' while the registry gives 'AUC 0.912' (different analyses, n=85 vs n=119).
The registry labels both papers 'MRI/PET'; neither uses PET.
resolution_note says 'Confirmed genuine' on a gap test that ignores P-183's own CI; the resolution field says 'Rejected'. The bridging list is generic.
what_would_change_the_verdict: The same class definition and input representation scored in both, with non-overlapping uncertainty.
